title: Old Radio Advertisements
paragraphs: Synthetic GRH archive collection of undated radio commercial and promotional clips. It is not treated as one historical broadcast series.

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include Tobacco advertising, Automotive advertising, Personal care advertising, Health and remedy advertising, Food and beverage advertising, and Network and program promotion.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Commercial radio advertising archive.
